title: Construction Noise by the UHC
description: The space by the University Health Centre (UHC) is undergoing a construction project, which have resulted in the closure of a portion of the sidewalk. The noice of construction work can be heared when passes by the UHC.

title: Cooking smoke near campus canteen
description: During dinner peak hours, heavy cooking smoke is released from the canteen exhaust. The smell spreads to nearby study areas and causes discomfort for students.

title: There is a noise issue.
description: The noise problem is prominent on the way to the Utown.

title: Vehicle exhaust at Kent Ridge Crescent bus stop
description: Bus and car traffic creates noticeable exhaust around the stop during busy periods.

title: Runoff and litter in drain near UTown
description: After rainfall, cloudy runoff and small pieces of litter are visible in the campus drain.

title: Litter accumulation in roadside drain near PGPR
description: Litter has accumulated along the roadside drain and may obstruct water flow after heavy rain.
